content.text:
This is an overhead photo of one plate of food from a cafeteria.
List every visible food on the plate, at most 20 items. For each item, estimate its weight in grams and its food energy in kilocalories (kcal).
Reply with only one JSON object in exactly this shape, and nothing else:
{"items": [{"name": "<food name>", "grams": <number>, "kcal": <number>}]}
Use an empty list if no food is visible.

{"items": [{"name": "Ham and pineapple pizza slice", "grams": 110, "kcal": 290}, {"name": "Ham and pineapple pizza slice", "grams": 100, "kcal": 265}, {"name": "Ham and pineapple pizza slice", "grams": 100, "kcal": 265}, {"name": "Ham and pineapple pizza slice (center)", "grams": 110, "kcal": 290}, {"name": "Fresh pineapple chunks", "grams": 130, "kcal": 65}, {"name": "Grilled chicken breast strips", "grams": 150, "kcal": 240}, {"name": "Cherry tomatoes", "grams": 90, "kcal": 16}]}
